description: Start a browser session (Chrome, Firefox, or Edge) that all other tools act on. Call this first. Only one session can be started this way: call stop_browser before starting another, or use session_create to run several browsers at once. The matching driver is downloaded automatically by Selenium Manager. Returns the session status.

browser.description: Which browser to launch: chrome (default), firefox, or edge. It must be installed on this machine.

browserArgs.description: Extra command-line flags for the browser, e.g. ['--incognito'] or ['--lang=de']. Default none.

headless.description: Run without a visible window (default false). Use true for CI or background runs, false when the user wants to watch.

pageLoadTimeoutMs.description: Maximum time a page load may take before navigate fails, in milliseconds (default 30000).

scriptTimeoutMs.description: Maximum time an asynchronous script may run, in milliseconds (default 30000).

windowSize.description: Initial window size, e.g. { width: 1440, height: 900 }. Change it later with the window tool's resize action.

name: start_browser
